svg.title: A year along the river — original Shan Shui renderer, sample commits
svg.desc: 1,417 fictional commits across 269 active days, grouped into 13 calendar months. Lingdong Huang’s original drawing functions generate these ink mountains, trees, pavilions, boats and people. Monthly commits set mountain scale; active days set texture and grove density. A ferry marks each active month. Each mountain’s month, represented date range, and commit total travel directly beneath it in the same scroll. The complete panorama repeats every 180 seconds. Reduced-motion preference stops the scroll.
svg.text: Mountain height scales with commits² · 150 commits = 2.25× the height of 100 · Sample history
